mapper.select: SELECT t.name FROM M_Schedule AS s LEFT OUTER JOIN M_TrainType AS t ON s.train_type_cd=t.train_type_cd WHERE s.schedule_cd=#{schedule_cd};

SELECT tc.train_car_cd, tc.train_car_number, tc.seat_type_cd, tct.name FROM M_Schedule s INNER JOIN M_TrainType tt ON s.train_type_cd = tt.train_type_cd INNER JOIN M_TrainSeries ts ON tt.train_series_cd = ts.train_series_cd INNER JOIN M_TrainCar tc ON tt.train_series_cd = tc.train_series_cd INNER JOIN M_SeatType st ON tc.seat_type_cd = st.seat_type_cd INNER JOIN M_TrainCarType tct ON st.train_car_type_cd = tct.train_car_type_cd WHERE s.schedule_cd = #{schedule_cd} ORDER BY tc.train_car_number ASC
